Senior Backend Engineer — Fleet Coordination

Acme Robotics is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our fleet coordination team.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience building backend services in Node.js or a similar server-side language
- Required: hands-on experience with distributed systems and eventual consistency trade-offs
- Must have experience designing and operating production APIs at scale
- Experience mentoring junior engineers and reviewing their code thoughtfully
- Comfortable communicating technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders

Bonus points for:
- Experience in the logistics, robotics, or supply-chain industry
- Familiarity with real-time systems or robotics middleware (ROS, etc.)
- Experience with PostgreSQL at scale

You will design and operate the services that coordinate our robot fleets in real time, working closely with the robotics and infra teams.
Software Engineer needed. Must know JavaScript.
Backend Engineer with 3+ years of Python experience required. Nice to have: AWS experience.
